# ECN-2026-049 Change notice - Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #3

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P2, line P2-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L4-HP03

## Reason for change
Lubrication history review identified inconsistent use of lubricant formulations in EQ-P2-L4-HP03. Standardize to the approved shop lubricant to reduce seal swell and wear variance, improve consistency of operation, and align maintenance consumables with inventory controls and procurement. This change clarifies the required lubricant part number for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #3 and establishes procedural updates to affected work instructions.

## Affected items
- EQ-P2-L4-HP03 lubrication specification: replace all references to unspecified or legacy lubricants with CFW-LUB-450.  
- Preventive maintenance and daily checklists for PRESS area on line P2-L4 that reference lubricant selection.  
- Spare parts and consumables inventory entries where lubricant selection for EQ-P2-L4-HP03 is documented.  
Related procedures: SOP-P2-L4-02, SOP-P2-L4-04, SOP-P2-L4-05.

## Implementation
- Effective immediately, use CFW-LUB-450 for all top-up, reservoir fill, and component light-lubrication tasks on EQ-P2-L4-HP03.  
- Update SOP-P2-L4-02, SOP-P2-L4-04, and SOP-P2-L4-05 to reflect CFW-LUB-450 as the specified lubricant for EQ-P2-L4-HP03.  
- Maintenance supervisors to audit current lubricant stocks and tag or segregate nonconforming containers from feedstock for EQ-P2-L4-HP03.  
- Train maintenance and operator personnel on the change via toolbox briefings; reference updated SOPs during briefings.  
- Record change of lubricant part number in equipment maintenance log and parts inventory record for EQ-P2-L4-HP03.

## Approvals
- Maintenance Manager: _________________________  
- Production Manager: _________________________  
- Quality Engineer: _________________________

Related documents for reference: SOP-P2-L4-02, SOP-P2-L4-04, SOP-P2-L4-05.
